machine.nproc_note: GNU nproc honours OMP_NUM_THREADS, so `nproc` can print 1 on a multi-core host; `nproc_all` is the core count.
machine.thread_env_note: NPROC sizes XLA's CPU intra-op pool (the JAX rows); the BLAS knobs pin OpenBLAS/MKL/OpenMP (the numpy/scipy rows) and do not touch JAX. Two disjoint families; both are recorded on every CPU timing.
machine.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 with Max-Q Design, 6144 MiB, 580.97

protocol.admissibility: prior AND stress pass (4a rule); prior pass + stress fail = diagnostic
protocol.timing_mode: per-row, executable released between rows (not interleaved A/B)
protocol.route_order: round-robin over every usable route, start rotated each round
protocol.cache_trap_guard: fresh closure + jax.clear_caches() per JIT route

verdict_rules.admissible: every considered oracle root covered by exactly one distinct candidate within tol on every judged draw-source, multiplicity agrees, no spurious candidate, no uncapped count above the row's cap

protocol.max_containing_size_patch: ArrayTriangles.__init__ / for_limits_and_scale __defaults__ + module constant, tracing (and eager calls) only, restored by value
